name: Loki

abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.

howToPlay: Loki için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mystic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Ascendant
Rising in power through sorcery and subterfuge, Loki generates one bar of Power over [12 - 5.45] seconds. as long as he is below 1 bar.

abilitySections.title: Basic Attacks
content: While the opponent is Cursed, Loki has a 17.5% chance to Stun the opponent for 1 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: While the opponent is Cursed, this attack deals guaranteed Critical Hits. Additionally, it has a 100% chance to reset the duration of Curse.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Steals all of the opponent's Buffs. Stolen Buffs last for 7.5 second(s).
65% chance to reset the duration of Curse.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: If Loki has more Health points than his opponent, he has a 100% chance of dealing Energy Damage equal to 7% of their max Health. This damage cannot exceed 100,000 damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Loki Curses the opponent, dealing [6,561.57] Energy Damage and allowing him to steal any of the opponent's Buffs for 10.5 seconds. Stolen Buffs last for 7 second(s).
